title: Bound mixed-target input-encoder capacity for the released source
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

For the unchanged released two-FULL/one-query source, an arbitrary admitted FREE input encoder mixing both original main banks still supplies at most 112 independent rank-17 main Gaussian jobs at sufficiently large widths. The written capacity proof permits mixed target ranks, rectangular readout, owned clean scratch and saved-original FREE bypass. It does not require an invertible t0 or input encoder.

Controls, encoder, readout, bypass **and target entry/exit charts** require fixed finite columnwise complete-product supports independent of width (or the retained canonical native target charts). Outer scalar coefficients may vary with width. Fixed weighted generators with unbounded width-dependent products are not covered. The nonlinear route projects the finite coefficient identity onto the full-Gaussian monomial double coset **before evaluation**, then bounds evaluated capacity through 112 fields; it does not assume an infinite algebra is faithfully represented.

The best granted target is `112 H17 + 112 H16 + 816 H9`. It and the retained paid profile have rank mass 11040, while target ranks are at least 9 and paid ranks at most 5. Thus the optimistic complete recursive moment loses strictly for every `0<C<1`; at C=0 masses tie. This is an exact inequality, not a root or numerical scan. No physical supplier/compiler/caller or κ improvement is claimed.

## Task and overlap

**task_id: `joint-query-controller`. Scope change:** allow FREE encoding across both 224 main inputs and mixed Gaussian targets, replacing the earlier unchanged-feed/all-H17 demand. Retain the exact source, two FULL calls, 112-H1 query bank, first three control memberships, autonomous 816 helpers and their billed completion.

Scientific source is `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`, `research/coded-native-caller`; #5126 context is `0e8a13c251a9be1029114cda8b4194f05f3a23ec`; Clifford predecessor #5160 is `7800589ce99d932bdb063aafca1f501f1a38626d`. The independently reviewed nonlinear partition proof is retained as exact source bytes and is now published in [#5210](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5210) at `bddbdfab1cdba27ce69ce4a83d9c92a5d9e66bd8`; it does not itself prove this changed-input result. Publication base is `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`, rechecked live by the sole monitor at 2026-10-23 12:48:22 UTC with all nine governing/selected blobs unchanged. Complete created/updated PR pagination through 12:45:32 UTC, cursor #5215, found no matching mixed original-input capacity result; this bounded check is not a novelty guarantee. No duplicate feed intake was performed.

Nearby [#5200](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5200), historical head `f6fa6d1930069ef52fce431250129819a3931767`, studies two pure calls with arbitrary/noncommuting q_i and reversible controls over a fixed finite monomial-Clifford algebra, restoring independent dirty workspace. Our retained billed 112-H1 query bank is an extra paid nonmonomial resource beyond that pure-two-call model. Its theorem is neighboring scope, not a dependency or a transfer used for this mixed-target capacity result.

Changed source O, native/history/helper paths, extra observations, paid controls, growing/noncolumnwise supports and changed target contracts are outside the result. Held investigations are not consumed. The original reports, pre-target-chart correction, conceptual feedback, both author metadata versions and independent freeze are preserved unchanged.

The subsequent #5200 head `c5a75152105119a91887a90aad6ed41e191d1d2f` now explicitly includes joint routing across arbitrary many main pairs, including 112. No bank-size gap is claimed. Its pure two-FULL theorem still excludes this package's extra 112-H1 query bank and mixed target demand.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/mixed-target-capacity-ceiling/verify.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/mixed-target-capacity-ceiling/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-target-capacity-ceiling --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-target-capacity-ceiling
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/mixed-target-capacity-ceiling --ref HEAD --check-source-history
```

Normal/O, registered replay, metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history checks and official export pass. Fresh Git-free normal/O replays regenerate both full scalar receipts byte for byte and leave exported bytes unchanged. The hook preserves all 26 author/review evidence files, reads the unchanged independent checker and privately mirrors the author checker's original source layout. It verifies 5,824 source edges, the mode Gram identity, source-row conventions, profile/census arithmetic and four scalar controls. The 113th-target mutation only checks a mass inconsistency; it is not a machine proof of the capacity bound. Written independent review supplies the capacity and all-C mathematics.

Standard-library CPython 3.12; about 1 second per direct run. No operator/native/source solver, compiler/Lean or historical helper suite is run. Raw source CRLF/LF bytes remain exact. Finite costs, raw-dual construction, precision/storage, helper-completion implementation and compiler/outer obligations remain open and cannot overturn the already negative optimistic necessary gate. Hosted first run [39956794777](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39956794777) passed at exact contribution head `e51bd17de70e32ff37c653d392c6b00f13d4b277`, tested merge `ae2626b55e5d5c88d411e914ba148d60c13fc68b` against base `ec2780e8aeb1c88acaf5e9e470ef8c68e7fbbb6c`. Plan job `120424518737` passed 414 tests with 17 skips in 207.029 seconds and selected this package alone. Replay job `120426531073` ran both normal/optimized hooks: `PASS_SCALAR_SOURCE_AND_MIXED_INVOICE_ONLY`, 26 evidence files, 5,824 source edges, four controls and equal 11,040 rank masses; complete author and independent receipts matched the frozen modes. Registered-package and committed-input checks passed. This is scalar source/invoice validation, not an operator/native/compiler/all-width capacity-theorem or κ replay.

Contribution head: `e51bd17de70e32ff37c653d392c6b00f13d4b277`.

## Credit

Root source-edge/capacity derivation, conceptual paper-worker feedback and separate independent mathematical/scalar review; Chris R/Clear1nsight packaging, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Retain Dillon's equations, Dugongue/mdumitrean code/profile, actual normalizer authors, Cinna Davis/1337isnot1337, Cao Yifan/intqwq, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman, Ryanson Jonathan and the native/helper/Clifford/compiler lineage. Apache-2.0 and original notices preserved. No independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.

## Open next questions

A useful reopening must change a source/control/observation or paid-invoice premise and exhibit an actual negative-bank rank-17 channel or cheaper complete bill, with source access, ownership, target charts and all finite costs. Merely changing the FREE input encoder, eigenbasis or mixed lower-rank list inside this scope cannot pass. Changed O and held native/history lanes remain separate; this submission neither searches nor stops those routes.
